description:
Check whether a password matches a bcrypt hash.

Returns: JSON { match: boolean }.
Example input: {"password":"s3cret!","hash":"$2a$10$abcdefghijklmnopqrstuv"}
On error, includes hint: `hash` must be a full bcrypt string starting with $2a$, $2b$, or $2y$.
name: bcrypt_verify
title: Bcrypt verify
